scope_notes: Actual Windows sockets traversed Wintun and the shared Core; upstream peers and verified DoT fixture were real loopback sockets, not public internet targets.
This recorded driver source covers TCP PROXY/REJECT/HTTP-403/connection-refused policy cases with reachable DIRECT traps. Later UDP policy smoke extensions are excluded.
The temporary adapter used exact test routes. Physical DNS and firewall were not modified; production port-53 guard and full-capture leakage were not tested.

The full configuration comparison retains all original adapters, ordered DNS and all ActiveStore routes, excluding time-decaying fields. It is an exact comparison of that schema, not every conceivable Windows setting.
Windows 11 applications, full physical egress/rebuild, crash recovery and long-duration soak acceptance remain untested.
